children: Prairie Operating entered into a letter agreement with High Trail on Aug. 30, 2026, to modify terms tied to its Series F Convertible Preferred Stock financing. The amendment shifts the Anniversary Warrant Issuance Date from Aug. 31, 2026 to Dec. 1, 2026 and updates related warrant form footnotes. It also extends to Dec. 1, 2026 the potential issuance date of a warrant for 3,000,000 common shares at $0.01 per share if the Anniversary Warrants are not issued by that date. The changes provide additional time and preserve optionality around warrant issuance mechanics.
: Letter agreement amending Securities Purchase Agreement and warrant issuance dates
: Extend warrant issuance deadlines and maintain flexibility
